ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with high-intensity (white/tan) pixels localized to distal tips and circular surface rings, estimated at less than 0.05:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity (black) region across >90% of fluke surface; high-contrast tan/white geometric clusters localized at both distal lobe tips; multiple sparse circular high-contrast ring-marks distributed across the mid-plane of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped central depression; calculated interior angle approximately 35 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 5 to 20 pixels, significantly distinct from the white background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Predominantly convex curvature extending from the notch toward the distal tips, ending in a slight posterior-facing hook at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 7-9 distinct high-contrast circular rings (rosettes) distributed across the central and upper regions of both lobes, ranging from 10-30 pixels in diameter.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of crustose barnacles concentrated on the extreme distal edges of both fluke lobes; multiple circular scarring events across the ventral surface.
